record.question: A key international convention relevant to the NDPS Act is:
record.explanation:
Correct Answer: B. Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961 ✅

Explanation
The Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961 is an international treaty aimed at controlling the production, manufacture, trade, and use of narcotic drugs while ensuring their availability for legitimate medical and scientific purposes.

India's Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985 was enacted partly to fulfil its obligations under international drug-control conventions.

Important conventions for MPSC exams
Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961 — Controls narcotic drugs.

Convention on Psychotropic Substances, 1971 — Controls psychotropic substances.

UN Convention Against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances, 1988 — Combats illegal drug trafficking.

Exam tip: Remember the sequence 1961 → 1971 → 1988 → NDPS Act, 1985 (the Act falls chronologically between 1971 and 1988).

The 1961 Convention is explicitly recognized under Section 2(ix) of the NDPS Act.
